_comment: First-person marine. Vector3 position + velocity for 3D motion. state.facing is updated by mouse-look in GameShell. WASD uses velocity_add_relative for diagonal movement (ADR 0004). drag=8.0 stops infinite slide. hide_for_camera_attach so first-person mesh isn't visible in front of camera. v2.5 adds current_weapon (1/2/3) + weapon_cooldown for the 3-weapon arsenal. v3.0 adds 'persistent' tag (ADR 0006) so HP/ammo/score/weapon survive level transitions.
